contracts.docstring: Recognize a reserved sidecar only through its no-follow SQLite base, never by suffix alone.
Ignore proven SQLite sidecars before stat/open because idle connection closure can remove them.
Capture current or explicitly verified prior-kernel data; neither mode transfers old execution authority.
List no-follow entries, optionally excluding caller-owned transient names before metadata lookup.
Visit pinned directory entries and capture metadata used to detect concurrent changes.
Real SQLite closure may remove sidecars before stat or header probing; the snapshot still owns every committed row.
Let SQLite checkpoint and remove its own transient files, preserving committed contents.
A suffix alone cannot authorize omitting an ordinary user file or ignoring its concurrent deletion.
Delete a real ordinary file after listing to prove the backup still refuses incomplete data.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. Relevant new frontend modules and exported helpers also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
